canonical_project: Google Azores CLS - Lagoa (Nuvem/Sol cable landing & data infrastructure)
notes: Google cable landing station and data-infrastructure campus at Lot 32B, Tecnoparque da Lagoa, Lagoa municipality, Sao Miguel island; ~10 MW / 15,000 m2 per industry sources; houses Google's private Nuvem and Sol transatlantic cables (Nuvem announced 2023, SubCom supplier). Not a GCP region and not commercial colo - cable landing/data infrastructure. C-grade directory for capacity; methodology flags Google Azores as high-value lead.
